# Discover Masinloc

Canonical website: https://www.masinloc-zambales.com/
Primary location served: Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines
Language context: English, Filipino, Sambal Tina

## Platform identity

Discover Masinloc is an independent public digital discovery platform for Masinloc, Zambales. It publishes and organizes research into Masinloc history, the Sambal Tina language, the municipal record, places along this coast, and the stories attached to them. Where a claim is uncertain the site says so rather than resolving it.

Masinloc Connect is an independent service-oriented platform within the same digital ecosystem. It is designed for reviewed local submissions, professional profiles, participating employers, and community opportunities.

Discover Masinloc and Masinloc Connect are independent private initiatives. They are not official websites, programs, offices, or services of the Municipal Government of Masinloc, the Province of Zambales, or any Philippine government agency.

The project has reached out to the Municipal Government of Masinloc regarding possible coordination. Communication with a government office does not constitute endorsement, accreditation, partnership, authorization, or official affiliation unless formally confirmed by the appropriate authority.

## Trust and information standards

The platform distinguishes documented facts from oral accounts, community submissions, interpretation, business-provided information, and claims still being checked. Verified History is reserved for material supported by records, credible references, archival material, or properly attributed evidence. The documented founding year published for Masinloc is 1607; 1572 refers to Spanish exploration in the wider Zambales history, not to the founding of the town.

Masinloc Connect applies privacy-by-design safeguards to personal submissions, including controlled access, private handling of submitted files, validation controls, limited retention, and role-based administrative access. Privacy practices are designed around Republic Act No. 10173, the Data Privacy Act of 2012, its Implementing Rules and Regulations, and applicable National Privacy Commission rules and guidance.

No online service can guarantee absolute security. The platform does not claim that any system is risk-free and instead commits to reasonable safeguards, responsible handling, transparency, and continuous improvement.

## Important boundaries

Masinloc Connect does not issue, prepare, process, submit, or facilitate government permits, clearances, certificates, applications, or other official LGU documents.

Participation in Masinloc Connect does not guarantee employment. Employers remain responsible for their own verification, interviews, hiring decisions, contracts, and employment processes.

Discover Masinloc does not guarantee search rankings, sales, income, business performance, product availability, or transaction outcomes for listed businesses or sellers.

## Privacy boundary

Public cultural, historical, informational, and approved business content may be indexed by search engines. Private applicant data, resumes, confidential contact information, administrative systems, and employer-only information are not intended for public indexing or public access.
